snippet.title: Fox Arcana - Official Gameplay teaser
snippet.description:
Fox Arcana is a survivor-style roguelike: Face off against monsters and guardians across the changing seasons!

You play as a unique Fox, the last protector of a cursed forest. Battle hordes of monsters, unleash Arcany powers, and challenge the Guardians of the Seasons in an endless cycle...

Whislist on steam, link in bio
